obfuscation_indicators: not material individually or in aggregate
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and explains the drivers of weaker 2012 performance, including a 4.6% sales decline, lower components demand, margin pressure, and reduced net income. Risk is heightened by limited customer and supplier visibility, competitive pricing pressure, acquisition activity, and reliance on adjustments such as pro forma and foreign-currency exclusions. Repetition and presentation changes modestly complicate comparability but do not appear deliberately evasive.
